row_guide: Band0 (y0–768): title + completed red example stack; red-brick modular kit (flat roofs, roof access, solid/window/balcony mids, glass grounds, sushi/florist/bakery shops, icons, shadows); blue kit roofs begin. Band1 (y768–1536): blue-grey kit mirrors red (roofs/mids/grounds/themed shops/icons/shadows); dark kit roofs start. Band2 (y1536–2304): dark kit walls/shops + pizza/burger/yogurt/ice-cream extra signs; sample teal-trim building; tiled/slanted roofs; HVAC/ATM roof props; multi-window/balcony/pillar/arch mid bands; condo ground entrances; Plume/CLOSED/Groove/Coolies boutiques. Band3 (y2304–3072): bakery/butchery/bait/ice-cream/fitness full shops+signs; cafe set; laundry; shadows; industrial walls/grates; roof utility cluster; olive window facade bands with doors/ATM/arch. Band4 (y3072–3840): dark facades; boutique row (Plume/CLOSED/Groove/Coolies/shutter/BimBum/DANGER); music piano/guitars + vinyl sign; empty shop; large bakery/butchery/bait/ice-cream/fitness variants; brick fillers; laundry; shadows. Band5 (y3840–4144): ice-cream/cafe/glass entrance/mesh fence; six billboards; gun store orange/blue/grey full+sign+base.
